blog/2026-06-26-lead/index.html.title: No More Shortcuts: Closed-Loop Driving Without Target Point Bias
blog/2026-06-26-lead/index.html.description: A retrospective on LEAD (CVPR 2026): three structural mismatches between privileged experts and sensor-based students in imitation learning for driving, why they matter more than model size, and the questions they leave open.

overrides.og:description: Looking back at LEAD: closed-loop driving struggles less for lack of model capacity than because of what the expert quietly teaches. Three fixes, and the doors they open.
